entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-12
entry.content:
Issues

  • Microsoft.DotNet.MSBuildSdkResolver.Tests fail locally #52408
  • dotnetup: Handle user-added dotnet install roots in PATH manipulation #52406
  • dotnet format fails for WPF related project due to implicit Debug configuration use #52403
  • `--no-progress` should be the default behavior for dotnet test in CI #52400
  • file-based app: #:package directive should allow package reference attributes, eg ExcludeAssets="runtime" and PrivateAssets="all" #52399

Closed

    10.0.2xx

    10.0.2xx

  • Enable setting RID for `dotnet restore` with `-a` and `--os` #51667
  • `dotnet test` mtp exit code is confusing #52107
  • [wasm][coreclr] update the wasm templates and make them work #51240
    11.0.1xx
